CD68 promoter‐mediated RANK expression is not sufficient to induce osteoclastogenesis in vivo.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
CD68 promoter does not target RANK expression in myeloid lineage cells, and CD68 expression is not necessary for osteoclastogenesis.
the CD68 promoter does not target myeloid precitors that can differentiate into osteoclasts, which are thought to be CD68 positive.
